senses.gloss:
pauṣadha (HA), Sanskrit uposatha; living like a Jain monk for 12 or 24 hours; the observance of fast on the eighth and fourteenth of the fortnight, the full-moon day and the day before the new moon and abstention from wicked acts, chastity, abandonment^1 of bathing, etc., i. e. living temporarily like a monk. See poṣadha.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210207. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/51.
